description: Header file defining RedisQtAdapter class for integrating Redis async context with Qt's socket notifier system, including friend functions and private methods for managing socket notifications.

classes.name: RedisQtAdapter
classes.description: Qt-based adapter class for Redis asynchronous context, managing socket notifications and integrating with Qt's signal/slot mechanism.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Associates a redisAsyncContext with the adapter and sets callback functions for socket events.

methods.name: addRead
methods.description: Creates a QSocketNotifier for read events if not already created.

methods.name: delRead
methods.description: Deletes the read socket notifier if it exists.

methods.name: addWrite
methods.description: Creates a QSocketNotifier for write events if not already created.

methods.name: delWrite
methods.description: Deletes the write socket notifier if it exists.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes both read and write socket notifiers.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Slot that handles read events, calling redisAsyncHandleRead.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Slot that handles write events, calling redisAsyncHandleWrite.
